extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective article creators / editors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who want to find, create, or request a new Wikipedia page (here: 'Comedy films of the 2020s'), including account requirements, search/redirect checks, and troubleshooting for missing pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only logged-in, autoconfirmed users may create articles. If you are not autoconfirmed yet, consider using the article wizard or requesting a new article (see alternate routes below).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create a page directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed) or prefer guided help, submit a draft via the article wizard or make a request for a new article so experienced editors can assist or review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles first
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Comedy films of the 2020s" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify whether the topic already exists under a different title or as part of another article to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examining inbound links can show whether content on the topic exists elsewhere and whether a redirect or rename is more appropriate than a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for database update delays
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect the page to exist (recent creation), try purging the page or waiting briefly before recreating — the database can take time to reflect recent edits/creations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify alternative capitalizations and possible existing pages under slightly different titles; if an existing page uses a different capitalization, create a redirect rather than a duplicate article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if missing
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A missing page may have been deleted; review the deletion log and deletion reasons to understand whether content was removed and whether recreation is appropriate.
